projects.name: Specialist
details: • Spearheaded the end-to-end transition and transformation of claims operations from Singapore, including project planning, knowledge transfer, and
process redesign, achieving a 20% efficiency gain and 20% reduction in processing time.
• Supported activity mapping, process documentation, and gap analysis during transition readiness assessments.
• Assisted in FTE estimation and productivity benchmarking for new service lines.
• Instituted SOPs and controls that improved claim registration accuracy by 15%, strengthened fraud-risk verification, and ensured SLA compliance.
• Guided a team of 11 analysts in refining resource allocation and shift planning, achieving a 15% reduction in TCO.
• Mentored team members to improve quality and reduce error rates by 12%.
• Developed performance dashboards to track TAT, SLA breaches, and client satisfaction, resulting in a 7% increase in client satisfaction (NPS).
